title: A merging procedure for labelings of bipartite graphs
summary: Let $G$ a bipartite graph with vertex bipartition $\{A,B\}$ and let $m=|E(G)|$. An $(A,B)$-uniformly ordered labeling of $G$ is a labeling $f\colon V\rightarrow [0,2m]$ which, among other conditions, requires that there exists $λ\in \mathbb N$ such that $f(a)\le λ$ and $f(b)>λ$ for all $a\in A$ and $b\in B$. The existence of such a labeling for $G$ implies the existence of a cyclic $G$-decomposition of $K_{2mx+1}$ for all positive integers $x$.
